name: context-nudge
description: A one-line nudge to compact or start fresh when a session's context passes 250k, 400k and 600k tokens, or after an hour idle at 150k or more.

size_thresholds_k.title: Size thresholds (k tokens)
size_thresholds_k.description: Comma-separated context sizes, in thousands of tokens, that each trigger one nudge.

idle_minutes.title: Idle minutes
idle_minutes.description: A pause this long in a large session triggers the cold-cache nudge.

idle_min_context_k.title: Idle nudge minimum (k tokens)
idle_min_context_k.description: Sessions smaller than this never get the cold-cache nudge.
